caseNameFull: Baxstrom v. Herold, State Hospital Director
attorneys: Petitioner pro se. Louis J. Lefkowitz, Attorney General of New York, Paxton Blair, Solicitor General, and Anthony J. Lokot, Assistant Attorney General, for respondent.

opinions.text: Ct. App. N. Y. Motion for leave to proceed in forma pauperis and petition for writ of certio-rari granted. Case transferred to the appellate docket.
